source.author: verg
source.text: Turnus ut infractos adverso Marte Latinos defecisse videt, sua nunc promissa reposci, se signari oculis, ultro implacabilis ardet attollitque animos.
source.text_original: Turnus ut infractos adverso Marte Latinos / defecisse videt, sua nunc promissa reposci, / se signari oculis, ultro implacabilis ardet / attollitque animos.
source.text_english: When Turnus sees that the Latins have been broken and have given way in the face of Mars, that his own promises are now being called for, and that he himself is being marked by the eyes of all, he burns with unyielding fury and raises his spirits even more.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: talibus Alcimede maeret; sed fortior Aeson attollens dictis animos:
reuse.text_original: ' / talibus Alcimede maeret; sed fortior Aeson / attollens dictis animos:
reuse.text_english: Alcimede mourns in such words; but Aeson, braver, lifting their spirits with his words:
